title: Add plural resource stacked_habits_count
description: Add the plural resource used to localize the habit-stack expand/collapse toggle ("%1$d stacked habit" / "%1$d stacked habits").
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="stacked_habits_count"> with "one" item "%1$d stacked habit" and "other" item "%1$d stacked habits"
exact_code:
<plurals name="stacked_habits_count">
        <item quantity="one">%1$d stacked habit</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$d stacked habits</item>
    </plurals>
